At the scan edge, the footprint spans 4.8299 km along scan and 2.0057 km along track, enclosing 9.6875 km². The ellipse is oriented with a track azimuth of 351.54°, so the long axis runs nearly north-south and the short axis east-west. At H3 resolution 8, this ellipse covers 10 hexagonal cells — the ranger's initial search grid.

VIIRS refinement shrinks the search zone dramatically: the refined footprint is 0.4947 km², covering only 1 H3 cell. This is the Point-Buffer Illusion in operational form: a MODIS detection is not a point but an area, and treating it as one risks searching the wrong ground.
